_note: Online play, from the council's New Player Primer and the Discord. Times are US Pacific; the page converts them to the reader's time zone.

weeklies.name: Webcam Weekly
weeklies.blurb: Paper cards (or proxies) on your own table, played over Discord's built-in video. It's the closest thing to playing in person.

weeklies.name: Cockatrice Weekly
weeklies.blurb: Played on Cockatrice, where every card ever printed is free to use. A good first tournament if you're still building your paper deck.

leagues.name: Webcam Async League
leagues.format: Four rounds of Swiss or a round robin, then Top 8.
leagues.note: Same as the weekly, just on your own schedule. Games run over Discord video.

leagues.name: Cockatrice Async League
leagues.format: Four rounds of Swiss or a round robin, then Top 8.
leagues.note: All you need is a computer.

clients.name: Discord video
clients.desc: Webcam games run on Discord's own video calls. Point a camera at your play area, hop into a voice channel with your opponent and play with your real cards or proxies.

clients.name: Cockatrice
clients.desc: Free and open source, with every card. The Discord's Cockatrice weekly and league run here, and it's great for testing a list before you buy anything.
